training.targets: One graph-preserving SMILES enumeration per selected training molecule per epoch

training.fallback: Original encodable sequence for frozen vocabulary or token-length rejection

pilot.sampling: same spectrum hash seeds and stable shared per-group forward
pilot.decision_requires: Structural improvement over current selected decoder before full2000 paired evaluation
